text:
Avery Lin: posting a new compact/expanded hybrid for the Usage & Billing dashboard. goal: let finance scan invoices quickly while product sees model-level token costs. fig: https://figma.redwood/compact-hybrid-v1 :mag:
Ben Cho: nice. can the compact card surface the top 3 model rows with USD visible? platform engs often triage cost spikes directly from dashboard
Nora Kim: yes, 3 rows max and a "+N more" overflow. suggest micro-sparkline above rows to show recent trend without taking vertical space
Maya R: when toggling org vs project scope, show a persistent breadcrumb chip: [Org: Redwood Corp] so users never lose context. also show small avatar if org has multi-account setup
Sam (PM): question on invoice CTA: on narrow widths can we collapse to icon-only? support flagged that icon-only was missed by some users before
Avery Lin: compromise: icon + screen-reader-only label + hover tooltip on desktop. on mobile long-press reveals full label. keeping text on desktop, icon-only at <440px with sr-only fallback
Ben Cho: UX tradeoff: sparkline vs stacked area for composition. stacked area is clearer for per-model share but cramped in compact. propose density toggle: compact = sparkline + inline rows, expanded = stacked area + legend
Nora Kim: copy tweak: change header from "Token Breakdown" to "Token cost by model" to reduce ambiguity for non-ML folks
Maya R: a11y: micro-table gray text fails contrast on our current palette. need >=4.5:1 for 14px. also chart controls require keyboard focus outlines and aria roles
QAbot: accessibility scan: micro-table contrast ratio 0.38 (FAIL). chart buttons missing tabindex and aria-pressed for toggle. invoice menu missing aria-haspopup and role=menu
Sam (PM): priority list for next release: 1) fix contrast + keyboard focus states, 2) ensure invoice download CTA is discoverable on mobile, 3) persist date range when switching scope. density toggle can be v2
Ben Cho: bulk invoice export: it must be async for large orgs. backend should return a job id + presigned URL when ready. UI: show toast + console notification with link and ETA
Nora Kim: filename pattern proposal: single CSV = "<org_slug>_<project_slug>_<YYYY-MM>_invoice.csv" (e.g., redwood-corp_project-alpha_2025-04_invoice.csv). zip for batch: "<org_slug>_invoices_<YYYY-MM>_to_<YYYY-MM>.zip"
Maya R: include a manifest.json inside the zip listing filenames + checksums and a small metadata file for accounting automation. makes reconciliation easier
Avery Lin: good idea. will add manifest line to design. also add an option in kebab menu to choose CSV vs XLSX per customer request
Ben Cho: security note: presigned links should be short-lived and single-use. backend should throttle generation and include a signed manifest for integrity
Sam (PM): UX for overflow: show top 3 projects inline then a lightweight modal for "+N" with search. modal must trap focus, set aria-modal=true, and restore focus on close
Nora Kim: modal accessibility checklist: initial focus on first interactive element, Escape closes, close button has aria-label, announce via aria-live when content loads
Maya R: small perf note: for orgs with hundreds of projects, virtualize the overflow list and render microbars using canvas WebGL to avoid DOM slowness
Avery Lin: tooltip schema for inline rows: Model | Tokens | Cost. snippet: `Model: string, Tokens: number, Cost: string USD`
QAbot: recommended ARIA updates: chart aria-label -> "30-day spend and token cost by model"; add aria-live region for export job updates; ensure keyboard focus visible on all interactive elements
Ben Cho: UX nit: when users switch from org -> project keep the same date range. resetting to default is disorienting
Sam (PM): agreement on filename example and manifest. prioritize accessibility fixes and mobile discoverability for invoice CTA. will queue density toggle + stacked area for next sprint
Avery Lin: thanks team. I'll update Figma with higher contrast, breadcrumb chip, icon+sr-only invoice CTA, async bulk export flow + manifest, and persistent date-range behavior. will post updated link here when ready :white_check_mark:
